Answer: A
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1b) demonstrates bilateral widening of the lower posterior mediastinum with lateral displacement of both paraspinal lines (indicated by arrowheads), a classic radiographic sign of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma involving the paravertebral regions. The smooth margins and lack of vertebral destruction or respiratory symptoms make neurogenic tumors, abscesses, or bronchogenic carcinoma less likely.
